project_type: Windows Local Web Control Center - .NET 8 Gateway + React/TypeScript Dashboard
language: C# (.NET 8) for backend, TypeScript for frontend
build_system: dotnet CLI for gateway, npm/vite for frontend
build_command: cd gateway && dotnet build; cd ../web && npm run build
test_command: cd gateway && dotnet test; cd ../web && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. Install .NET 8 SDK, 2. Build gateway with dotnet build, 3. Build frontend with npm install && npm run build, 4. Verify gateway serves on port 8088
setup_instructions: wget https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -O dotnet-install.sh && chmod +x dotnet-install.sh && ./dotnet-install.sh --channel 8.0 && export DOTNET_ROOT=$HOME/.dotnet && export PATH=$PATH:$DOTNET_ROOT
environment_constraints: .NET SDK must be installed manually via dotnet-install.sh. Node.js 22 available via nvm. Full internet access (OPEN_INTERNET).
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - follow the folder structure defined in requirements
key_patterns: ASP.NET Core Minimal API pattern, MQTTnet for MQTT, EF Core or Dapper for SQLite, SignalR for real-time, Serilog for logging, React with TypeScript + Vite for frontend
directory_structure: windows-control-center/ with gateway/ (ASP.NET Core), web/ (React+Vite), installer/, docs/, specs/, README.md
